title: Choose field mappings first
summary: A mapping tells Elasticsearch how a field should be searched.
introduction: A mapping tells Elasticsearch how a field should be searched. Your task: Explain why kind is a keyword while title is text.
learningObjectives: Explain why kind is a keyword while title is text.
Explain the example for choose field mappings first

blocks.text: A mapping tells Elasticsearch how a field should be searched. text is for analysed words, while keyword is for exact values.

Use a local Elasticsearch 8+ instance with Kibana Dev Tools. Paste the HTTP request examples into that console. Use only the cma-books practice index. This website does not connect to an Elasticsearch server.
Read the code step by step

items: An Elasticsearch mapping chooses how each field is indexed. Text and keyword have different search meanings.

blocks.text: A new empty practice index is created with explicit field types.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Create this separate index once. A field's type cannot simply be changed in place after incompatible data is indexed.
